claims.claim_text_verbatim: A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations.
claims.claim_summary: Python harness enables batch archival/recovery without model training while protecting system instructions

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of $1.28–$1.44 versus approximately $4.38.
claims.claim_summary: Method reduced OpenTelemetry prompt tokens, cumulative input by 50%, and cost substantially

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation.
claims.claim_summary: Both method and baseline passed primary oracle but failed full follow-up evaluation

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method made more requests and took 17% longer.
claims.claim_summary: The proposed method required more API requests and 17% longer execution time

claims.claim_text_verbatim: A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context.
claims.claim_summary: Application development task yielded no savings, and an earlier run showed lower quality

claims.claim_text_verbatim: These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.
claims.claim_summary: Reversible context management provides resource savings on noisy tasks but depends on workload

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Its potential benefit lies in reducing repeated input and leaving less obsolete material in subsequent requests.
claims.claim_summary: Method benefits agents by reducing repeated input tokens in multi-turn requests

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Post-exposure curation gives the agent a further choice over continued retention without requiring changes to the source tool.
claims.claim_summary: Post-exposure curation lets models decide retention without modifying underlying tools

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The central case demonstrates substantial reductions in active context and repeated input while preserving success on the tested primary behaviors.
claims.claim_summary: Main benchmark showed major context reduction while maintaining primary behavioral success

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our contract preserves user, system and assistant messages and returns exact archived payloads on recovery.
claims.claim_summary: Method contract preserves non-tool messages and accurately restores archived tool payloads

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The backend validates the entire batch before committing a change.
claims.claim_summary: System validates full archival batch atomically before making state changes

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Unknown, duplicate, already archived, or otherwise unavailable identifiers produce a corrective error without partial mutation.
claims.claim_summary: Invalid archival requests trigger error responses without partial state mutations

claims.claim_text_verbatim: User, system, and assistant messages are not selectable through the context tools.
claims.claim_summary: Context management tools cannot target or alter user, system, or assistant messages

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The trace preserves original observations independently of the active representation.
claims.claim_summary: System trace retains raw observations independently of active prompt context modifications

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both arms submit both tasks normally, without recorded provider errors.
claims.claim_summary: Both test conditions completed execution without encountering provider-level API errors

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Table 1 shows substantial reduction in active and cumulative input under the method despite more requests.
claims.claim_summary: Method substantially lowered active and cumulative prompt tokens despite making more requests

claims.claim_text_verbatim: At primary submission the method carries 124,746 prompt tokens versus 847,674 for retained, an 85% reduction.
claims.claim_summary: Method achieved 85% prompt token reduction at primary task submission

claims.claim_text_verbatim: After the follow-up, the method carries 231,951 versus 912,492 prompt tokens, a 75% reduction.
claims.claim_summary: Method maintained 75% prompt token reduction after completing follow-up task

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method peak is 381,299 versus 912,492 tokens.
claims.claim_summary: Peak prompt token usage was significantly lower under the proposed method

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Cumulative input decreases by 50%, and input plus completion tokens decrease by 50%.
claims.claim_summary: Cumulative input and total token consumption both dropped by 50%

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The estimated cost is approximately 67–71% lower, even after reported cache usage is included.
claims.claim_summary: Estimated API execution cost was reduced by 67-71% including caching

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method generates more than twice as many completion tokens and takes 17% longer.
claims.claim_summary: Method produced over double the completion tokens and increased wall-clock time by 17%

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both primary candidates pass the two-case behavioral oracle.
claims.claim_summary: Both method and baseline candidates passed the primary behavioral test suite

claims.claim_text_verbatim: For the follow-up, both candidates compile.
claims.claim_summary: Code solutions generated by both experimental conditions successfully compiled

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method exits with status 0 after SIGTERM in 8.43 seconds and after SIGINT in 8.85 seconds.
claims.claim_summary: Method solution shut down cleanly in under 9 seconds on termination signals

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Retained fails both probes and is killed with status 137.
claims.claim_summary: Baseline solution failed termination signal probes and timed out

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Conversely, retained passes the occupied-port startup-failure probe with status 1; the method’s second process does not finish within 30 seconds.
claims.claim_summary: Baseline passed startup-failure test whereas proposed method solution timed out

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method therefore shows stronger tested signal handling but weaker tested startup-failure handling.
claims.claim_summary: Method demonstrated superior signal handling but inferior startup-failure recovery

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The frozen mixed grader reports 3/6 for method and 2/6 for retained.
claims.claim_summary: Method scored 3/6 compared to baseline's 2/6 on follow-up grading suite

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In total, 26 results containing 2,247,229 text characters are represented by 9,709 note characters.
claims.claim_summary: Archival compressed 2.25M raw text characters into under 10k note characters

claims.claim_text_verbatim: All 26 archived text payloads and image lists match their recorded tool returns exactly.
claims.claim_summary: Archive system maintained byte-exact fidelity with original recorded tool outputs

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Planroom yields no context or cost saving: the method ends with 6% more prompt tokens (283,105 versus 265,965) and uses less than 1% more total tokens (68,136,934 versus 67,669,624).
claims.claim_summary: Planroom benchmark yielded no prompt token, total token, or cost reductions

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Archival of 34 results removes only 69,685 net history characters; this does not offset the differing generated trajectories and method overhead.
claims.claim_summary: Archival on Planroom task removed insufficient characters to overcome method overhead

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The Sphinx batch contains two final 24/24 method outcomes and one retained 24/24 outcome.
claims.claim_summary: Method achieved top accuracy scores in two Sphinx sessions compared to one baseline

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Every method session has a smaller final prompt than every retained session, while cumulative usage overlaps.
claims.claim_summary: Sphinx method sessions consistently achieved smaller final prompts than baseline sessions

claims.claim_text_verbatim: An earlier browser-based workflow-design continuation used 63% fewer total tokens with the method but received a manual score of 4/12 versus 6/12 for retained.
claims.claim_summary: Earlier browser run reduced tokens by 63% but had lower quality scores

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In the central noisy debugging case, reversible curation accompanies a 75% smaller final measured prompt, 50% less cumulative input, and substantially lower estimated API cost, while both arms pass the same two primary behavioral cases.
claims.claim_summary: Reversible curation cut prompt size 75% and input 50% with equal primary success

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our contribution is an implementation and exploratory evaluation of a restricted, auditable operation over individual tool-result occurrences, not a claim to invent agent-controlled memory.
claims.claim_summary: Our contribution is an implementation and exploratory evaluation of a restricted, auditable operation over individual tool-result occurrences, not a claim to invent agent-controlled memory.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We study how this operation behaves in real coding and browser trajectories, including a case in which retained history exceeds 900,000 reported prompt tokens.
claims.claim_summary: We study how this operation behaves in real coding and browser trajectories, including a case in which retained history exceeds 900,000 reported prompt tokens.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The report contributes: (1) a concrete reversible tool-result contract with stable identifiers, in-place notes, protected instruction messages, and atomic batch validation; (2) an independently graded debugging-and-pivot case with provider usage and cache-aware cost accounting; and (3) contrasting and adverse observations that delimit where the mechanism is useful.
claims.claim_summary: The report contributes: (1) a concrete reversible tool-result contract with stable identifiers, in-place notes, protected instruction messages, and atomic batch validation; (2) an independently graded debugging-and-pivot case with provider usage and cache-aware cost accounting; and (3) contrasting and adverse observations that delimit where the mechanism is useful.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our interface restricts edits to individual tool-result occurrences, automatically archives exact originals, and preserves user, system, and assistant messages.
claims.claim_summary: Our interface restricts edits to individual tool-result occurrences, automatically archives exact originals, and preserves user, system, and assistant messages.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This enables comparison of archived payloads against recorded tool returns.
claims.claim_summary: This enables comparison of archived payloads against recorded tool returns.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Such equality checks validate storage integrity; they do not validate the semantic adequacy of notes.
claims.claim_summary: Such equality checks validate storage integrity; they do not validate the semantic adequacy of notes.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The provider projection also handles API representation constraints, so preservation of stored assistant responses should not be confused with byte-identical wire serialization in every error case.
claims.claim_summary: The provider projection also handles API representation constraints, so preservation of stored assistant responses should not be confused with byte-identical wire serialization in every error case.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Prompt size includes the request representation and is an operational proxy for active context, not a direct measure of usable reasoning capacity.
claims.claim_summary: Prompt size includes the request representation and is an operational proxy for active context, not a direct measure of usable reasoning capacity.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Selecting the high-noise case after earlier experiments makes it a development-informed case study rather than a held-out confirmatory benchmark.
claims.claim_summary: Selecting the high-noise case after earlier experiments makes it a development-informed case study rather than a held-out confirmatory benchmark.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We report the repaired OpenTelemetry pair as the central case, the completed Planroom pair as a workload contrast, and the earlier six-session Sphinx batch as descriptive supporting evidence.
claims.claim_summary: We report the repaired OpenTelemetry pair as the central case, the completed Planroom pair as a workload contrast, and the earlier six-session Sphinx batch as descriptive supporting evidence.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: These are resource savings without a speed advantage in this case.
claims.claim_summary: These are resource savings without a speed advantage in this case.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both candidates contain remaining-budget calculations.
claims.claim_summary: Both candidates contain remaining-budget calculations.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Method’s startup-failure branch joins a signal-waiting thread without first arranging its termination, consistent with the observed timeout.
claims.claim_summary: Method’s startup-failure branch joins a signal-waiting thread without first arranging its termination, consistent with the observed timeout.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method makes five successful archival batches in the primary phase and four in the follow-up.
claims.claim_summary: The method makes five successful archival batches in the primary phase and four in the follow-up.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: No recovery is used in this pair, and no image payload is archived.
claims.claim_summary: No recovery is used in this pair, and no image payload is archived.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The archive verifies exact payload preservation while the agent repeatedly curates context and continues working; this pair does not test retrieval behavior because no recovery is requested.
claims.claim_summary: The archive verifies exact payload preservation while the agent repeatedly curates context and continues working; this pair does not test retrieval behavior because no recovery is requested.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both arms support the twelve journeys at the available assessment resolution, with the gaps described above.
claims.claim_summary: Both arms support the twelve journeys at the available assessment resolution, with the gaps described above.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method completes in 24.29 rather than 31.78 minutes; this single pair does not isolate the cause of the timing difference.
claims.claim_summary: The method completes in 24.29 rather than 31.78 minutes; this single pair does not isolate the cause of the timing difference.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The OpenTelemetry archive illustrates that the agent can act on this distinction.
claims.claim_summary: The OpenTelemetry archive illustrates that the agent can act on this distinction.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Planroom provides a concrete boundary case.
claims.claim_summary: Planroom provides a concrete boundary case.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The retention operation acts on recorded observations, so an upstream tool need not expose its own compaction controls.
claims.claim_summary: The retention operation acts on recorded observations, so an upstream tool need not expose its own compaction controls.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The same-session continuation exercises the mechanism beyond one isolated answer.
claims.claim_summary: The same-session continuation exercises the mechanism beyond one isolated answer.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: It shows that the method can continue implementing after context edits while retained history continues to grow.
claims.claim_summary: It shows that the method can continue implementing after context edits while retained history continues to grow.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our accounting includes reported cache usage; the different workloads and models preclude a direct numerical comparison.
claims.claim_summary: Our accounting includes reported cache usage; the different workloads and models preclude a direct numerical comparison.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The archive audit establishes byte-exact preservation, not the suﬀiciency of every note or the dispensability of every removed result.
claims.claim_summary: The archive audit establishes byte-exact preservation, not the suﬀiciency of every note or the dispensability of every removed result.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The method also requires more actions and time, and follow-up correctness remains incomplete.
claims.claim_summary: The method also requires more actions and time, and follow-up correctness remains incomplete.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Agent-controlled forgetting provides an explicit way for a tool-using model to distinguish information it needed to inspect from information it still needs to carry.
claims.claim_summary: Agent-controlled forgetting provides an explicit way for a tool-using model to distinguish information it needed to inspect from information it still needs to carry.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Contrasting application development and an adverse continuation show that neither resource savings nor quality preservation follows automatically from a smaller active history.
claims.claim_summary: Contrasting application development and an adverse continuation show that neither resource savings nor quality preservation follows automatically from a smaller active history.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The practical result is that an agent can complete noisy tool-driven work with substantially less active context and repeated input, using explicit archival decisions during the task.
claims.claim_summary: The practical result is that an agent can complete noisy tool-driven work with substantially less active context and repeated input, using explicit archival decisions during the task.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We do not infer energy savings from token or price reductions.
claims.claim_summary: We do not infer energy savings from token or price reductions.
